title: TopoFlow: Evolutionarily Conditioned Flow Matching for Protein Conformational Ensemble Generation
authors: Xinguang Yang; Xinyue Cui; Xuhui LI; Dongliang Hou; Suhui Wang; Tengyu Xie; Guijun Zhang
one_liner_zh: TopoFlow 提出一种进化条件流匹配框架，融合 MSA 进化表征与 VAE 结构潜变量生成蛋白质构象系综，在 MD 基准和实验观测上优于 BioEmu，核心贡献于蛋白质构象生成计算建模。
abstract: Proteins function through dynamic conformational ensembles rather than a single static structure, yet accurately modeling these ensembles remains challenging. Here, we introduce TopoFlow, an evolutionarily conditioned flow-matching framework for protein conformational ensemble generation. TopoFlow uses evolutionary representations from multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) to encode global conformational heterogeneity. It combines this with structural variables from a variational autoencoder (VAE) to capture local flexibility. These complementary representations are then adaptively fused through a conditional modulation module to construct unified conditioning features that guide protein conformational ensemble generation. On the ATLAS molecular dynamics (MD) benchmark, TopoFlow improved the Jensen Shannon metrics for pairwise distances (JS-PwD), radius of gyration (JS-Rg), and time-lagged independent components (JS-TIC) by 10.73%, 5.78% and 7.75%, respectively, relative to BioEmu. Notably, this performance generalizes to experiment-based evaluation, where TopoFlow exhibits strong agreement with experimental observables, including chemical shifts (CS) and small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS). Ablation analyses further indicated that the evolutionary representations and structural latent variables contributed complementary information to ensemble generation. Our results suggest that TopoFlow, through its integration of evolutionary and structural latent information, offers a promising strategy for generating structurally plausible and conformationally informative protein ensembles.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质通过动态构象集合而非单一静态结构发挥功能，然而准确建模这些集合仍具挑战性。在此，我们引入TopoFlow，一种进化条件化的流匹配框架，用于蛋白质构象集合生成。TopoFlow利用多序列比对（MSAs）的进化表示来编码全局构象异质性，并将其与变分自编码器（VAE）的结构变量相结合，以捕捉局部灵活性。这些互补表示随后通过条件调制模块自适应融合，构建统一的调节特征，指导蛋白质构象集合生成。在ATLAS分子动力学（MD）基准上，相对于BioEmu，TopoFlow将成对距离的Jensen Shannon指标（JS-PwD）、回转半径（JS-Rg）和时间滞后独立成分（JS-TIC）分别提高了10.73%、5.78%和7.75%。值得注意的是，这一性能推广至基于实验的评估，其中TopoFlow与实验观测值（包括化学位移（CS）和小角X射线散射（SAXS））表现出强烈一致性。消融分析进一步表明，进化表示和结构潜变量为集合生成贡献了互补信息。我们的结果表明，TopoFlow通过整合进化和结构潜信息，为生成结构合理且构象信息丰富的蛋白质集合提供了一种有前景的策略。
